name: solana-guestbook
description: Web3 Edge Fullstack Application: On-Chain Guestbook with Solana, Cloudflare Workers & React

scripts.frontend:deploy: pnpm run build:frontend && cd frontend && wrangler deploy
scripts.worker:dev: cd worker && export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" && wrangler dev
scripts.worker:deploy: cd worker && export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" && wrangler deploy
scripts.worker:init-d1: cd worker && wrangler d1 execute guestbook-db --local --file=./schema.sql
scripts.worker:init-d1:remote: cd worker && wrangler d1 execute guestbook-db --remote --file=./schema.sql
scripts.test:rust: cd worker && export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" && cargo test
scripts.clean:rust: cd worker && export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" && cargo clean
